title: BlenderScene
description: A fully resolved Blender scene for one shot (ADR 0004): every object, material, light, camera keyframe and render setting as a value, in Blender's own units and axes (metres, Z up, degrees in rotation fields named so), so that blender/apply_scene.py makes bpy calls and takes no decision. Written by src/lanes/blender/ as scene.json beside the frames; the applier reads it and renders.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

shotId.description: The shot the scene renders, as the shot spec names it, for example "s01".

output.description: Where and how the frames are written.

directory.description: Absolute directory the PNG frames go to, with forward slashes, for example C:/vf/cache/<key>/frames.

fileStem.description: The file name pattern Blender fills the frame number into and appends .png to: every # is one digit, so "f######" gives f000000.png for frame 0, the cache's own naming (src/render/cache.ts).

frameStart.description: First Blender frame to render, 0 or more; Blender frame k is shot frame k, for example 0.

frameEnd.description: Last Blender frame to render, inclusive, at or above frameStart, for example 119.

fps.description: Frames per second of the scene's timeline, for example 30.

width.description: Frame width in pixels, for example 1920.

height.description: Frame height in pixels, for example 1080.

render.description: The engine and its sampling; both engines' settings are given so the applier sets them without choosing.

cycles.description: Cycles sampling and the compute device.

samples.description: Path-tracing samples per pixel, for example 128.

deviceTypes.description: The preference device types to enable, for example ["OPTIX", "CPU"]; every device whose type is listed is used.

items.description: A device type as Cycles names it, for example "OPTIX".

motionBlur.description: Motion blur across the shutter window.

shutter.description: Shutter time in frames: the shutter angle divided by 360, so 0.5 is a 180-degree shutter.

colorManagement.description: The view transform and exposure of the output (ADR 0008 decision 2).

exposure.description: Exposure in EV stops applied by the view, for example -0.3.

world.description: The world: a background colour and, optionally, an HDRI environment.

strength.description: Strength of the background colour's light, for example 0.2.

hdriPath.description: Absolute path of the .hdr environment image with forward slashes, or null for the plain colour.

hdriStrength.description: Strength of the environment image's light, for example 0.6.

hdriRotationZRad.description: Rotation of the environment about Blender's Z axis in radians (converted from degrees in TypeScript, since the applier does no arithmetic), for example 0.

camera.description: The one camera, keyframed per frame from the shared camera model.

sensorWidthMm.description: Sensor width in millimetres with sensor_fit AUTO (the larger image axis), always 36.

clipStartM.description: Near clip distance in metres, for example 0.02.

clipEndM.description: Far clip distance in metres, for example 100.

useDof.description: True to render depth of field from the keyframed f-stop and focus distance.

keyframes.description: One keyframe per Blender frame from frameStart to frameEnd, plus the bake's frame before and after the batch when it exists so the motion blur shutter window sees the motion at the batch's ends; in order; linear interpolation between them.

materials.description: Principled BSDF materials, created before the objects that name them.

empties.description: Empties used as pivots (the turntable), created before the objects that name them as parent.

objects.description: The meshes in creation order: primitives from Blender's own operators and explicit meshes from vertices.

lights.description: Area lights, placed and keyframed in Blender's axes.

ColorDepth.description: Bits per channel of the PNG frames, as Blender's color_depth names them.

BlenderEngine.description: The render engine identifier of Blender 5.x: BLENDER_EEVEE or CYCLES.

Denoiser.description: The Cycles denoiser: OPTIX on an RTX GPU, OPENIMAGEDENOISE elsewhere.

CyclesDevice.description: Whether Cycles renders on the CPU or on the enabled GPU devices.

ComputeDeviceType.description: The Cycles preferences' compute device type; NONE for a CPU render.

ViewTransform.description: The view transform of the output: AgX for the agx tone mapping token, Standard for the standard token.

LightShape.description: The shape of an area light.

ObjectKind.description: How an object is created: a Blender primitive operator (cube, cylinder, uv-sphere, torus, plane) or an explicit mesh from vertices and faces.

LinearRgb.description: A colour in linear light, each channel 0 to 1 (Blender's colour sockets), for example red 0.8, green 0.6, blue 0.2.

Vector.description: A point, offset, scale or XYZ Euler rotation (radians) in Blender's axes (X right, Y into the screen, Z up), in metres for positions and sizes, for example x 0, y -2.2, z 0.3.

Quaternion.description: A unit rotation quaternion in Blender's (w, x, y, z) order, the same rotation the shared camera model bakes, mapped to Z up.

CameraKeyframe.description: The camera at one Blender frame.

frame.description: The Blender frame number, 0 or more (shot frame k).

lensMm.description: Focal length in millimetres, for example 85.

focusDistanceM.description: Distance to the focus plane in metres, for example 1.2.

Material.description: One Principled BSDF material, every socket given.

ior.description: Index of refraction, 1 or more, for example 1.45.

Empty.description: An empty object used as a pivot, with its rotation about Z keyframed.

rotationZKeyframes.description: The pivot's rotation about Z per Blender frame, with the bake's frame before and after the batch when it exists (the shutter window); empty when it never turns.

RotationZKeyframe.description: A rotation about Z at one Blender frame.

frame.description: The Blender frame number, 0 or more (shot frame k).

radians.description: Rotation about Z in radians, counter-clockwise seen from above (converted from degrees in TypeScript).

SceneObject.description: One mesh object: a primitive from its operator parameters, or an explicit mesh from vertices and faces; every field is given for every kind and the applier passes the ones its kind reads.

material.description: Name of one of the scene's materials.

parent.description: Name of the empty the object is parented to, or null.

shadeSmooth.description: True to shade the mesh smooth.

radiusM.description: Radius in metres for a cylinder or a uv-sphere; 0 for other kinds.

depthM.description: Depth (height) in metres for a cylinder; 0 for other kinds.

vertices.description: Segment count for a cylinder or a uv-sphere's segments; 3 or more for every kind (unused kinds pass 3).

majorRadiusM.description: Major radius in metres for a torus; 0 for other kinds.

minorRadiusM.description: Minor (tube) radius in metres for a torus; 0 for other kinds.

sizeM.description: Edge length in metres for a cube or a plane; 0 for other kinds.

meshVertices.description: The vertices of an explicit mesh, in metres relative to the object's location; empty for primitives.

meshFaces.description: The faces of an explicit mesh as lists of vertex indices into meshVertices, counter-clockwise seen from outside; empty for primitives.

items.description: One face's vertex indices, three or more.

AreaLight.description: One area light with its location keyframed when it moves (the light sweep).

sizeYM.description: Height in metres (read for RECTANGLE; given for every shape).

powerW.description: Power in watts (Blender's energy), for example 150.

useTemperature.description: True to colour the light by temperatureK (Blender's use_temperature); false to use color (a tinted rim).

temperatureK.description: Colour temperature in kelvin, 800 to 12000 (Blender's range), for example 5600.

locationKeyframes.description: The light's location per Blender frame when it moves, with the bake's frame before and after the batch when it exists (the shutter window); empty for a static light.

LocationKeyframe.description: A location at one Blender frame.

frame.description: The Blender frame number, 0 or more (shot frame k).
